_how: The links of the shared files in the MATH Sitefinity library. Steps: docs/03-shared-files.md. Paste each link between the quotes as Sitefinity shows it (http:// is fine), save, then run: node tools/check-cms-links.mjs MATH. Upload ccm-styles.css last. The IBM Plex Sans Arabic links are optional (Arabic text only). Open Sans is not uploaded: the site's theme already has it.
